product_summary: Shigan Quantum Technologies Ltd (IMT Manesar, Gurugram, Haryana; reg. office Sainik Farms, New Delhi) is an automotive Tier-1 / EMS manufacturer of alternate-fuel and safety systems. Real product lines taken from its own catalogue pages: (1) Engine Area — CNG regulators 'HPR Tyrion' 2/5/7/8.5 bar (ISO 15500, ECE R110), gas fuel injectors (SQT P&H, SQT Saturated, AEC Low/Standard Flow, IG4 Dakota; >1 million injectors made), CNG HP/LP filters, ECU, fuel rail, RPT sensor, gas pressure sensor, LNG filter, LNG reducer/regulator, HP solenoid assy; (2) Chassis Area — CNG receptacle NGV1/NGV2, FMFD (fast-fill nozzle + gauge + filter + valve assembly), SS-316L high-pressure tubing (CNC bent, IS-15716), LP solenoid assy; (3) Fire Safety Components — N2 pressure regulator, water tank 80–155 L, nitrogen tank 6.4/10 L (PESO approved), FDSS canister, water spray nozzle (AIS-135), electronic control panel, horn strobe/hooter, heat & smoke detector (EN54-5/-7); (4) EV components (page listed in menu, itemised page returned 404); (5) Electronic Manufacturing Services — SMT/PCB assembly, box build, mechanical assemblies (IATF 16949, ISO 14001/45001, RoHS). Declared HS 870899 (other parts and accessories of motor vehicles of 8701–8705) is only a residual basket code: it can loosely cover the chassis-area mountings and some assemblies sold as vehicle parts, but it does not describe the dominant reality — pressure regulators, valves, injectors, filters, sensors, fire-suppression hardware, gas cylinders and PCBA. Those are classified in Chapters 84, 85, 90 and 73, not 87. Industry label 'Авиастроение и транспорт' (aircraft building and transport) is a misclassification: the site shows no aerospace activity at all — sectors named are automotive, locomotive, marine, power generation, farm and off-highway. No customs line, shipping bill or B-L was reviewed in this task, so every product above is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' (declared on the company website, not corroborated by a customs record).
role_hint: manufacturer (own plant at IMT Manesar with stated in-house injector manufacturing, CNC tube bending, SMT lines; ISO 15500 / ECE R110 / IATF 16949 certifications claimed). No trader signs found on the catalogue pages. Note: the site also advertises contract manufacturing / job work / box-build for third parties, i.e. a service component alongside own-product manufacturing.
comment: HS mismatch, not a rejection ground — company stays in the base with corrected codes (rule 3). Declared 870899 is a residual motor-vehicle-parts code and is at best partially correct: it fits only the chassis-area mechanical assemblies. The bulk of the catalogue — CNG/LNG/N2 regulators and solenoid valves (8481), gas injectors (8413), engine filters (8421), pressure sensors (9026), fire detection and suppression panels/detectors/canisters (8537, 8531, 8424), nitrogen cylinders (7311), SS high-pressure tubing (7304), PCBA/EMS (8534, 8542) — belongs outside Chapter 87. Recommend declaring the actual mix per invoice rather than a single 870899 line. Industry field 'Авиастроение и транспорт' should be corrected to automotive components / alternate-fuel systems / electronics manufacturing; no aviation evidence on the site. Product lines missing from the declaration: fire safety systems (FDSS, N2/water suppression), gas cylinders, EMS/PCBA contract manufacturing, EV components. All product data sourced from shiganquantum.com (home, /engine-area/, /chassis/, /fire-safety-components/, /electronic-manufacturing-services/); the EV components page returned HTTP 404, so that line is listed as declared-only. No customs, shipping-bill or B-L record was examined here — status for all items: заявлено, не подтверждено. Revenue, export volumes, PAN and registry data deliberately not researched in this task.
